prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1493; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you were involved in. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state the location where the collision occurred.

A: It was in the parking lot of a shopping center in Sugar Land, Texas, near the main entrance.

Q: Can you describe what you were doing just before the collision?

A: I had just pulled into a parking space and was backing out to leave. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything, so I started reversing slowly.

Q: What happened next?

A: A silver sedan coming down the aisle hit the rear driver's side of my vehicle. I felt a hard jolt and my car moved sideways a little.

Q: Did you stop your vehicle right away?

A: Yes, I stopped immediately. I put the car in park and sat there for a minute because my shoulder started hurting.

Q: Can you describe your injury?

A: My right shoulder hit the door frame and the seatbelt pulled hard across my chest. It's sore, and I have trouble lifting my arm above my head.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, a store employee called for help, and I was taken to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They took X-rays and gave me a sling and some pain medication.

Q: Has anyone else been injured?

A: No, the other driver and their passenger said they were fine.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: I just want to make sure my medical bills and time off work get covered. I'm hoping we can get this sorted out.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
